summary: Transient role suppression following Okta group merge prevents console access for subset of engineers
description: Several engineers reported being unable to access the Redwood Console after an Okta group merge/cleanup activity. Affected users received 403s from the console but could authenticate to Okta successfully. Initial hypothesis: SCIM provisioning event removed an intermediate mapped group used by our RBAC rules, causing a temporary role suppression rather than full deprovisioning.
impact: ~18 engineers across infra and analytics lost Console access for ~45 minutes during business hours. No customer-facing services impacted, but on-call runbooks and incident triage workflows were blocked for impacted staff.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Okta admin merges group 'eng-sre-temp' into 'eng-sre' via Okta admin console with SCIM provisioning enabled.
2) SCIM sync runs immediately and sends membership deltas to our identity service.
3) Affected users attempt to open app.redwood.internal/console and complete SSO redirect to Okta.
4) After SAML assertion, console returns HTTP 403 with 'role assignment missing' in response body.
5) Killing browser session and reauthenticating occasionally returns access (inconsistent).

investigation_notes: 09:20 - Nikhil: Confirmed Okta group merge event timestamp matches start of failure window. SCIM deltas show the intermediate group 'eng-sre-temp' removed before our role-mapping job processed the merge.

09:35 - IAM team: Role-evaluator expects stable intermediate mapping keys; the merge created a short window where mappingKey lookup returned 404 and evaluator treated that as explicit removal rather than transient rename.

09:40 - SRE: Console auth path did not return 500s but returned 403s; telemetry shows role-set empty for affected tokens. Session tokens created prior to remediation worked until TTL expiry (hence intermittent reconnections worked sometimes).
10:05 - Confirmed SCIM retries are configured but our identity-service applied policy 'treat_missing_as_removed' which caused immediate role suppression.
10:30 - Reproduced locally by simulating SCIM: remove intermediate group then re-add; role-evaluator suppressed roles during gap until reconciliation task ran.

Priya Kapoor (IAM) 2026-03-01T09:36: 'IAM config has a safety rule that interprets missing mapping as removal for immediate security posture; this prevented graceful transition during merges.'
Diego Alvarez (SRE) 2026-03-01T10:00: 'Applied manual backfill via admin API for 18 users. Monitoring to ensure sessions re-evaluate roles on next auth. Will run bulk-reconcile.'

resolution: Applied manual mapping backfill for 18 impacted users and kicked the bulk-reconcile job to fix group-to-role mappings. Changed identity-service policy from 'treat_missing_as_removed' to 'treat_missing_as_pending' for group-merge events to avoid immediate suppression. Deployed a small hotfix to the role-evaluator to tolerate transient 404s during SCIM deltas. Verified access restored and validated by running smoke auth tests across sample users.
follow_up_actions: Create postmortem documenting root cause and timeline (owner: Nikhil).
Add an alert for sudden increase in 'role-evaluator: resolved_roles=[]' errors (owner: SRE).
Add integration test that simulates Okta group merges and validates role continuity (owner: IAM).
Update runbook: include bulk-reconcile job name and admin-api backfill steps (owner: SupportOps).
Schedule a config review to avoid policies that aggressively remove roles during SCIM syncs (owner: Security).
